nodes.name: Water Electrolysis with NiZnFe4Ox Catalyst
nodes.procedure: Water electrolysis is performed using NiZnFe4Ox catalyst on the anode side under an external magnetic field of 450 mT in alkaline media (KOH). The catalyst consists of zinc, iron, and nickel transition metals. The iron metals in the catalyst act as supplements to enhance hydrogen production as iron is a metal component in the active sites and F-S clusters of hydrogenase enzymes. The nickel metal acts as a hydrogen production accelerated material owing to its high resistance to corrosion and significant over-potential reduction capability. The zinc metal provides a porous structure and crack formation, making the catalyst more effective for the hydrogen evolution reaction.
nodes.method: Electrochemical water splitting with magnetic field
nodes.source_text: NiZnFe4Ox catalyst under a 450 mT of external magnetic field outperformed all the catalysts studied in this paper with a 6.54% energy efficiency improvement... The iron metals in the catalyst can be utilized as supplements to enhance hydrogen production since iron is a metal component in the active sites and F-S clusters of the [Fe], [Fe-Fe], and [Fe-Ni] hydrogenase enzymes... the nickel metal in the catalyst can act as a hydrogen production accelerated material owing to its high resistance to corrosion and significant over-potential reduction capability... The Zn metal in this catalyst can provide a porous structure and crack formation, making the catalyst more effective for the hydrogen evaluation reaction.

nodes.name: Water Electrolysis with PtNi Nanowires Catalyst
nodes.procedure: Water electrolysis is performed using PtNi(N) nanowires catalyst on the cathode side in alkaline media (KOH). The platinum nickel nanowires show excellent activity and comparable performance to platinum-based catalysts for hydrogen evolution reaction.
nodes.method: Electrochemical hydrogen evolution with platinum nickel nanowires
nodes.source_text: Platinum nickel nanowires are among the HER catalysts that provided significant improvements... Platinum nickel nanowires reduced 5.8 kWh of electricity consumption to produce a Nm3 of hydrogen to 5.3 kWh.

nodes.name: Water Electrolysis with Co2MnO4 Catalyst
nodes.procedure: Water electrolysis is performed using Co2MnO4 catalyst on the anode side in acidic media (H2SO4) for PEM electrolysis. The cobalt manganese oxide catalyst shows significant improvement in energy efficiency due to its different effects, including the binding affinity of oxygen, and demonstrates better lifetime.
nodes.method: Electrochemical oxygen evolution in acidic media
nodes.source_text: Among these catalysts, Co2MnO4 showed a significant improvement in energy efficiency of the water electrolysis process, a 4.79% improvement. The better catalytic activity of Co2MnO4 can be explained by its different effects, including the binding affinity of oxygen. Moreover, a better lifetime was mentioned for Co2MnO4.
